questions.question: What does Azure DNS do?

options.text: Hosts DNS domains and provides name resolution

options.why: Azure DNS does not sell domains.

questions.explanation: Azure DNS hosts DNS zones on Azure infrastructure.

questions.question: You want names to resolve to private IP addresses only inside your virtual networks. What should you use?

options.why: Public zones resolve on the internet.

questions.explanation: Private DNS zones resolve names within VNets.

questions.question: Which TWO features can secure Azure DNS zones?
questions.explanation: DNS zones benefit from RBAC, locks and activity logs.
